name: frustration
quote: I can't figure out how to solve it!
description: The sense that you've been repeatedly blocked from reaching a desired outcome and anxiety that failure may be near.
perceptions: So far I've been unable to complete this outcome.
I've tried several things and nothing's working.

guidance.description: If you have a low tolerance for frustration, there are strategies you can use to improve the way you respond. Seeking professional treatment is also a good option, especially if you're experiencing an underlying condition or your low tolerance is causing negative consequences in your life.

comparisons.description: An annoyance is a minor distraction that may slow but doesn't stop progress towards a goal. Frustration is the sense that you're blocked and not making any progress.
As the frustration of being blocked continues, you may start to feel discouraged that the outcome is not possible or that you are unable to reach it.

variations.name: social frustration
variations.description: The sense that a social goal is being blocked by someone.
perceptions: So far I've been unable to complete this outcome.
I've tried several things and nothing's working.
Someone is stopping me from reaching this outcome.
examples: I think I deserve employee of the month, but my boss doesn't like me.

variations.name: self frustration
variations.description: A sense that there must be something wrong with your own abilities for not being able to achieve the outcome.
perceptions: So far I've been unable to complete this outcome.
I've tried several things and nothing's working.
Perhaps the problem is with me.

guidance.description: One of the most common things I see in people who write to me is something we all share: disappointment in ourselves.

examples: unable to win a sports contest
unable to figure out what's wrong with the spreadsheet

variations.name: bad luck frustration
variations.description: A sense of injustice that you keep getting blocked from a certain outcome by chance events.
perceptions: So far I've been unable to complete this outcome.
I've tried several times and nothing's working.

guidance.description: 'Some people have all the luck.' Have you ever had this thought? It’s time to get rid of it once and for all. Those people aren’t blessed by luck – they have made conscious decisions to do these nine things.

examples: This is the fourth time I've had to reschedule the picnic!

commentaries.quote: Frustration is proportional to the fear of failure.
It is hardly possible to build anything if frustration, bitterness, and a mood of helplessness prevail.
To conquer frustration, one must remain intensely focused on the outcome, not the obstacles.
Our fatigue is often caused not by work, but by worry, frustration and resentment.
